initialPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: production transparent wing-flap and blink sprite atlas for the approved CLASSIC SEAGULL in Reef Hop.
Input 1 is the selected classic gull identity authority. Input 2 Rosie is material/lighting/rounded glossy 3D style authority. Input 3 reef scene is world consistency authority. Input 4 fish atlas illustrates only the 4-column, 2-row, eight-cell organization and the 6 movement + 2 eye-only alternate pattern.
Produce ONE sprite sheet, 2048 x 1024 pixels, exactly FOUR equal columns and TWO equal rows, eight 512 x 512 cells. No borders, no labels, no text. Genuine transparent empty pixels outside each bird; NO glow, NO shadow cloud, NO coloured halo, no background. One complete LEFT-FACING classic gull per cell, same side/three-quarter view as selected reference, same friendly open beak, white round body and head, large glossy eye, orange beak/feet, grey-white wings with charcoal tips. Preserve selected identity, not an owl.
STRICT REGISTRATION: in every cell the center of visible eye is at local (175,260), beak tip at (95,282), head and body unchanged in size, position, lighting and orientation; body center at (290,310), small feet trailing near (360,355). Fixed camera and scale. Only wings articulate from the shoulders. Use identical head, body, beak, tail and feet in all eight cells. No body bobbing, no rotation or scaling. All wing tips stay inside local cell with at least 15 pixels padding.
Reading order left to right then next row:
1: eye OPEN, wings at highest point, both raised like selected reference.
2: eye OPEN, wings descending halfway, angled upward about 25 degrees.
3: eye OPEN, wings at lowest point, swept down about 50 degrees; don't cover eye or head.
4: eye OPEN, wings lowest turning pose, slightly swept back.
5: eye OPEN, wings rising halfway, approximately horizontal with gentle feather flex.
6: eye OPEN, wings rising high, about 55 degrees, smoothly returning to pose 1.
7: EXACT DUPLICATE OF CELL 2 except eyelid halfway closed. Same wing pose, head, body, tail, feet, alpha silhouette; eye-only substitution.
8: EXACT DUPLICATE OF CELL 3 except eye fully closed with a soft curved eyelid. Same wing pose, head, body, tail, feet, alpha silhouette; eye-only substitution.
Make substantial readable flight stroke from wings up to wings down, coherent anatomical attachments. Smooth rounded sculpted feathers, clean silhouette, soft dimensional lighting matching reference. The complete sheet is for direct equal-cell extraction into Phaser, not a contact sheet presentation.
refinementPrompt:
Edit the supplied gull sprite atlas (image 1). Images 2 and 3 are approved classic gull identity and Rosie material/style references. Produce the same 4-column 2-row eight-cell transparent sprite atlas. Keep the existing bird identity, face, beak, head, body, tail, feet, lighting, camera, scale and positioning. TRUE transparent background with no glow. Remove no feathers or limbs.
Targeted correction: wing-flap intermediates need a smooth six-pose downstroke and upstroke. Number cells in reading order 1-8.
Cell 1: keep highest wings-up pose.
Cell 2: change wings ONLY to a clearly mid-downstroke pose: near wing extends BACKWARDS/RIGHT from its shoulder almost horizontally, its charcoal feather tips at about the shoulder's height (roughly local y=290); far wing extends left/up at a shallow angle, well clear of the head. Both wings significantly lower than cell 1, NOT raised high. Eye fully open.
Cell 3: keep fully lowered wing pose. Eye fully open.
Cell 4: keep low/back-swept turnaround wing pose. Eye fully open.
Cell 5: change wings ONLY to mid-upstroke: near wing extends backwards/right almost horizontally with slightly flexed feathers; tips about shoulder height (local y=280). Far wing partly foreshortened. Eye fully open.
Cell 6: keep nearly highest wings-up return pose, eye fully open.
Cell 7: exact duplicate of CORRECTED CELL 2 with ONLY the eye halfway closed; identical body, head, wings, feet, tail and alpha silhouette to cell2.
Cell 8: exact duplicate of CELL 3 with ONLY the eye fully closed; identical body, head, wings, feet, tail and alpha silhouette to cell3.
Fixed head/eye registration across all cells is critical. All complete wing tips inside each cell, generous padding. No text, no grid lines, no backdrop. Output one 2048x1024 atlas with equal 512x512 cells.
assembly: Registered poses by beak/head; extracted complete connected bird silhouettes beyond grid boundaries; uniform padding and scale into 512px cells; registered eye-only RGB donor composites with unchanged base alpha.
